title: dryopteris linnaeana var. jessoensis
intro: Dryopteris linnaeana var. jessoensis, commonly known as Jesso's wood fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Jesso's wood fern include its ability to act as a diuretic, helping to remove excess fluids from the body, and its potential to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its therapeutic effects.
